subject: Money
title: Crypto and Taxes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Crypto and Taxes.

hook.text: Every crypto trade is a taxable event in most countries. Swap Bitcoin for Ethereum? That's a sale. You owe tax on gains.

buildup.text: Governments treat crypto as property, not currency. Selling, swapping, or spending triggers capital gains calculations.

discovery.text: Blockchains are public. Tax authorities use analytics firms to trace transactions. Crypto being untraceable is a myth.

twist.text: Many early crypto users didn't report gains. The IRS now asks about crypto on every tax return. Audits are increasing.

climax.text: Crypto tax software exists, but tracking hundreds of trades across wallets and exchanges is a nightmare for traders.

punchline.text: The taxman sees the blockchain too.

quiz.question: How do most countries treat cryptocurrency for tax purposes?
options: As property subject to capital gains tax
